answer: The protocol requires agents to maintain 1,000 unique data shards as a digital kernel for identity, verified by unpredictable retrieval audits. An honest agent incurs a baseline disk cost, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times that expense to mirror distinct content across the network. Like an ember kept alive, shards are audited before rewards trigger. The system treats identity like a fable of scale, yet the verifier enforces integrity at a knoll of data depth. Any failure to return segments triggers an immediate, non-refundable slash to prevent collusion.
